root_idea.summary: The root has two documented semantic orientations: dark or altered coloration, and taking hold of something with the hand.
root_idea.development: The color branch develops into discoloration, fire-marks, dark patches, and color descriptors. The hand-taking branch yields seizing by the forelock and related extensions to striking and assault.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form سَفَعَ rather than the inflected QAC morphology token.

senses.definition: To seize by the forelock and drag.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction with بِالنَّاصِيَةِ, the forelock is seized as the means of dragging the person, with the Fire given as the destination in the surrounding interpretation.

senses.definition: To blacken or mark the face with a punitive mark.
senses.usage_conditions: An alternative interpretation of the Quranic construction takes the forelock as the front part of the face and understands the action as blackening it or marking it with the mark of the people of the Fire.

senses.definition: To abase, humiliate, or render despicable.
senses.usage_conditions: This is another reported interpretation of the same Quranic expression; associated explanations include bringing the person to stand in abasement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To scorch or smite lightly, altering the color of the external skin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of the action of hot wind, fire, or the sun upon a person or the person's face; the effect may include blackening.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a mark upon something with a hot iron or with fire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional transitive use distinct from merely scorching or discoloring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To slap, strike, or beat; of a bird, to strike with the wing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be a person or thing; the bird usage refers to striking with one or both wings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become black tinged with red.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a thing that takes on the color termed سُفْعَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strike, beat, or assault one another; to fight reciprocally.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form III construction presents reciprocal action between adversaries.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To embrace one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form III use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To warm oneself by a fire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The fire is expressed with بِالنَّارِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For one's color to become altered.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The alteration is attributed to fear or a comparable condition such as disease.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become swollen or develop a tumor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verbal noun is compared with a state of swelling or puffing up.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put on or clothe oneself in a garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The use applies to putting on one's clothing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fire-mark that alters a person's color.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal designation for a mark caused by fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment, especially a dyed garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural is سُفُوعٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The spathe or spadix of the tree called ظِمْخٌ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized botanical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stroke or touch attributed to a devil, madness, possession, or the evil eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may describe an affliction understood as a devil's touch or an evil-eye stroke.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dark discoloration or patch, especially blackness tinged with red.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is used for discoloration on the face or cheeks and for dark spots or specks; it can also describe a visible change of color caused by anger.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dark patch in the traces of a house that contrasts with the surrounding ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may consist of compacted ash, sweepings, dung, or sand left in the former site of a dwelling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who seizes a forelock.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested especially of seizing a horse's forelock in order to mount it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Burning blasts of the hot wind called سَمُوم.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural lexical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Black or black tinged with red; dark in coloration.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a color descriptor for people, animals, and cloth, including a garment or animal with dark coloration or dark cheeks.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hawk; also a pigeon marked by a dark patch on the neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are lexicalized animal uses associated with dark markings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A term used in calling sheep or goats, or a she-goat, to be milked.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional calling term rather than a general color description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The stones supporting a cooking pot, or an iron trivet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name is associated with the blackness of these cooking supports.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The seeds or grain of the colocynth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural or collective nominal use associated with the seeds' blackness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Blackened by rust, or marked with black spots.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a man clad in armor blackened by rust and to a bull with black spots on its face.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person affected or struck by the evil eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial description of someone suffering that affliction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person whose eye is sunken or depressed in the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The specification العَيْنِ identifies the affected body part.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One engaged in reciprocal striking, beating, or assault.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The participle describes each of two parties who strike or attack one another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lion that prostrates its prey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized figurative application of the attacking sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Embracing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A participial use corresponding to reciprocal embracing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having sexual intercourse without marriage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional use equated with مُسَافِحٌ; it describes intercourse outside a marital relationship.
